#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    std::vector<int> runLengths;
    int currentLength = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= (int)s.length(); i++) {
        if (i == (int)s.length() || s[i] != s[i - 1]) {
            runLengths.push_back(currentLength);
            currentLength = 1;
        } else {
            currentLength++;
        }
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int length : runLengths) {
        if ((length & 1) == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
